## Dual credit

The goal is for you to start earning college credit while you are still in high school. Nothing to do yet, but here is where we are:

- [ ] Confirm which local college accepts homeschool dual credit students
- [ ] Check the placement test requirement
- [ ] Pick a first course

## Keeping records

Save a copy of every graded assignment, test, and lab report in your school folder. At the end of the year we use those to build your transcript. If it is not saved, it did not happen.
